features_auto_derived_from_nodes: Auto: derived from the nodes inside. Manual: you set it, like any other node. Off: not shown.

features_preselected_kind_when_you: Preselected kind when you press N.
features_preselected_focus_tier_new: Preselected focus tier for new nodes.
features_how_canvas_places_draws: How the canvas places and draws things.
features_lay_out_new_unplaced: Lay out new and unplaced nodes on the canvas automatically and pin them where they land. Off: they wait in the canvas's Unplaced panel until you drag them in.
features_snap_to_grid_help: Align dragged canvas items to the grid.
features_grid_snap_step_help: Choose the step as a fraction of a visible grid cell.
features_dropping_node_into_path: Dropping a node into a path box that's too small for it makes the box bigger.
features_name_each_connection_canvas: Name each connection on the canvas (requires, next, related) in small text above its line.
features_worked_this_log_what: The "worked on this" log, and what happens to nodes it hasn't seen in a while.
features_show_poke_button_dashboard: Show the Poke button on dashboard and board cards.
features_poke_also_switches_node: A poke also switches the node's status to Active, and a poke that un-stales a paused node resumes it.
features_days_without_poke_since: Days without a poke (or since creation) before a node goes stale. Only a poke within this window - live or backdated - un-stales it.
features_dashboard_lists_nodes_this: The dashboard lists nodes this many days before they go stale. 0 turns the warning off.
features_ideas_never_do_they: Ideas never do - they're just ideas. Done and archived nodes never do.
features_active_node_that_goes: An active node that goes stale is paused (once - resuming it by hand doesn't re-pause it). It stays marked stale until poked.
features_active_periods_tracked_at: With active periods tracked: at the last poke (only real work counts), or when the node went stale (the idle stretch stays in).
features_any_latest_poke_inside: Any: the latest poke inside is past the threshold. All: every node in play inside is stale (done ones, and unstale idea/queued/paused ones, don't count). Off: paths never go stale.
features_how_status_focus_changes: How status and focus changes are recorded on the timeline.
features_pausing_closes_current_active: Pausing closes the current active period; reactivating starts a new one. Off: reactivating continues the last period.
features_changing_focus_node_open: Changing the focus of a node with an open active period ends it and starts a new one under the new focus, so the timeline shows focus over time. Off: periods keep their focus until you edit it.
